live.notFoundSub: It may have ended or been removed.

go.title: Go live
go.audioOnlySub: Your live is voice only. Listeners see your cover photo and can ask to join you on stage.
go.coverHint: Optional. Shown on the live list and behind the stage.

privacy.publicSub: Anyone on FLYP can find and join your live.
privacy.privateSub: Nobody else can join. Useful for a test run.

go.rules: Lives follow the FLYP community guidelines. Anyone can report a live.
go.micBody: A live is your voice. Allow FLYP to use the microphone in Settings to go live.
go.coverRefused: This cover photo can't be used. Choose another one or go live without a cover.
go.coverFailed: Couldn't upload the cover photo. Try again or go live without one.
go.startFailed: Couldn't start your live. Check your connection and try again.

guest.requestedBody: The host will see your request. Withdraw it?
guest.invitedBody: {{name}} invited you to speak on stage. Everyone in the live will hear you.
guest.onStageBody: Everyone in the live can hear you now. Use the mic button to mute.
guest.removedBody: The host moved you back to the audience.

chat.longPressHint: Long press to report or block

gifts.title: Send a gift
gifts.lowBody: Top up your wallet to send this gift.

report.title: Report
report.failed: Couldn't send your report. Try again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: They won't be able to comment in your lives or contact you, and you won't see their comments.

end.title: End your live?
end.body: The live ends for everyone and can't be resumed.
end.failed: Couldn't end the live. Try again.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.not_host: Only the host can do that.
errors.host_is_you: You're the host of this live.
errors.blocked: You can't do that with this account.
errors.not_watching: That person isn't in the live any more.
errors.removed_by_host: The host removed you from the stage. You can't ask again in this live.
errors.too_soon: Please wait a minute before trying again.
errors.no_invitation: The invitation is no longer open.
errors.no_request: That request is no longer open.
errors.live_guests_unavailable: Guests on stage aren't available yet.
errors.comment_too_long: Comments can be up to 500 characters.
errors.content_blocked: This can't be posted because it breaks the community guidelines.
errors.gift_not_found: This gift isn't available any more.
errors.gift_invalid_price: This gift can't be sent right now.
errors.gift_no_recipient: Choose who to send the gift to.
errors.gift_to_self: You can't send a gift to yourself.
errors.gift_recipient_not_in_live: That person isn't on stage any more.
errors.agora_forbidden: You don't have permission to speak in this live.
errors.agora_unavailable: The audio service isn't reachable. Check your connection.
errors.agora_no_token: The audio service didn't answer. Try again.
errors.agora_not_installed: Live audio isn't available in this build of the app.
errors.agora_join_failed: Couldn't connect the audio. Try leaving and joining again.
errors.mic_denied: Microphone access is off, so nobody can hear you.
errors.same_uid_login: This live is open on another device with your account.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.balanceFailed: Couldn't load your balance. Tap to retry.
wallet.balanceSub: Use coins to send gifts in lives.
wallet.how2: Pay securely through {{store}}. FLYP never sees your card details.
wallet.how3: Your coins arrive once {{store}} confirms the purchase.
wallet.priceNote: Prices are set by {{store}} in your local currency.
wallet.loadFailed: Couldn't load this. Pull to refresh.
wallet.storeUnavailable: Couldn't reach {{store}}, so coins can't be bought right now. Check that you're signed in to {{store}} and online.
wallet.simulator: Buying coins needs a real phone. It isn't available in a simulator or emulator.
wallet.unsupported: Coins can only be bought in the FLYP app on iPhone or Android.

result.creditedBody_one: {{n}} coin was added to your wallet.
result.creditedBody_other: {{n}} coins were added to your wallet.
result.pendingBody: {{store}} is still processing your payment. Your coins are added automatically once it's complete.
result.retryLaterBody: We couldn't confirm your purchase with {{store}} yet. We'll keep trying automatically. You won't be charged again, and your coins will arrive.
result.otherAccountBody: This purchase was made from another FLYP account, so its coins were added to that account.
result.otherAccountWaitBody: This purchase was made from another FLYP account. Sign in to that account to receive its coins.
result.invalidBody: {{store}} didn't confirm this purchase, so no coins were added. If you were charged, request a refund from {{store}}.
result.failedBody: {{store}} couldn't complete the purchase. You haven't been charged. Please try again.
